description: This source file implements utilities for managing and manipulating distributed model state dictionaries, including methods for gathering, offloading, copying, broadcasting, and flattening nested state dictionaries containing tensors, DTensors, and ShardedTensors in a PyTorch distributed environment.

classes.name: CompanionMismatch
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating mismatches between companion objects and tensors during state dict operations.

classes.name: _TensorInfo
classes.description: NamedTuple used to store tensor size and dtype information for broadcasting and validation purposes.

methods.description: A simple identity function returning the input tensor unchanged.

methods.description: Gathers all shards of a ShardedTensor across the distributed group into a complete tensor.

methods.description: Recursively traverses a state dictionary, applying functions to tensors, DTensors, ShardedTensors, or nested structures.

methods.description: Gathers ShardedTensor and DTensor objects from a state dict across the distributed group.

methods.description: Offloads all tensors in the state dict to CPU memory.

methods.description: Copies tensors from one state dict into another, preserving structure and references.

methods.description: Creates a new state dict identical in structure, with all tensors on CPU, optionally pinned or shared.

methods.description: Checks if two state dicts have the same structure and matching tensor sizes and dtypes.

methods.description: Distributes a tensor to local devices, handling DTensors and standard tensors.
